marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind northeast 20 knots diminishing to light Tuesday
afternoon. Scattered flurries. Temperatures near minus 3. Outside the ice edge freezing spray Tuesday morning and
afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 this
evening and to 2 to 3 Tuesday morning. Seas subsiding to 1 to 2 Tuesday
afternoon and to 1 or less early Tuesday evening.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Wednesday: Wind light increasing to north 20 knots in
 the afternoon.<br/>Thursday: Wind light becoming northeast 15
 knots.<br/>Friday: Wind south 20 knots veering to west 15 late in
 the day.<br/>
